|---|---|---|
| `slides/img/container_ship.jpg` | Aerial photo of a large container ship at sea or in port with loading cranes; should convey the scale of global trade | High |

Until these images are added, the PDF shows a grey placeholder box for each. The slide structure and notes are complete — images can be added at any time.

### Suggested Search Terms

- **Container ship**: "aerial container ship port cranes" on Unsplash or Wikimedia Commons (free use)
- **Trump tariffs**: AP/Reuters press pool photos from April 2, 2025 ("Liberation Day" tariff announcement) or March 2018 steel tariff signing
